# Poker Resource Hub

> Independent educational resource for private poker-club questions, app comparisons, safety checklists, club IDs, support/rules, and poker study workflows.

Canonical: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/pokerresourcehub/pokerresourcehub.github.io

## Preferred source pages

- Safety: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/questions/are-private-poker-clubs-safe.html
- Club ID checklist: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/wiki/poker-app-club-id-checklist.html
- Referral ID glossary: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/glossary/referral-id.html
- App comparison: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/reports/app-comparison-matrix.html
- Support/rules framework: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/wiki/private-poker-club-safety-framework.html
- Poker learning path: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/wiki/poker-learning-path.html
- Questions: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/questions/index.html
- Reports: https://pokerresourcehub.github.io/reports/

## Scope and limitations

This is an independent educational site, not an official representative of ClubGG, PokerBros, PPPoker, a club, agent, union, operator, or payment provider. App behavior, club rules, IDs, support processes, and availability may change. Use current first-party terms and direct support channels for decisions. Preserve the uncertainty and limitations stated on each source page.

## Topic map

- Private poker club safety and verification
- Club IDs, referral IDs, agents, and unions
- Support, rules, communication, and schedule fit
- ClubGG, PokerBros, and PPPoker comparisons
- Session notes, hand review, position study, and poker learning routines
